tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: gnam chos thugs gter snyan brgyud las: rdo rje 'jigs byed sgrub thabs bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈ ྈ na mo ya mān+ta ka ya: rdo rje 'jigs byed sgrub pa ni: drug cu'i gtor ma dpe'u ris ltar bca': bdag nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: sku mdog sngon po mdun gyi de rnams kyang: zhal gcig ma he'i zhal dang phyag bzhi pa: gri gug thod khrag mdung dang rdo rje 'dzin: thams cad khro bo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: mdun du gtso bo gcig la 'khor bcus bskor: oṃ ya ma rā tsa hūm̐ phaṭa: mdun sngags: rang sngags: oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa: rgyas pa'am 'bring po gang bcas kyang: nyin re chung ba bco lnga 'bul: dbus gsum shar gsum lho gsum dang: nub gsum byang gsum 'bul ba yin: 'bul ba'i sngags ni 'di nyid bzla: oṃ ya ma rā dza: sa do me ya: ya me do ru: ṇa yo da ya: ya da yo ni: ra ya k+ṣe ya: ya k+ṣe yats+tsha: ni ra ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu h+ya: kha thaṃ: ྈྈྈྈ ces pa 'di ni sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje dgung lo bcu gnyis me sprel khrums zla ba'i nyer gsum nub bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dngos su zhal gzigs dus thub pas dngos su bka' bstsal pa'o: zhal gdams ni zhal bzhi phan la mi mdzad ces gsungs so: 'di'i bdag bskyed rgyun du'ang rung gsungs: mdun bskyed bsnyen pa ya ma ra: ༈ rdo rje 'jigs byed drug cu'i gtor sgrub bsdus pa bzhugs lags so// na mo ya mān+ta ka ya/ 'jigs byed snyan brgyud drug cu'i gtor sgrub ni/ maṇ+ḍal me tog tshom bu bcu gcig bkod// de steng drug cu'i gtor ma gzhung ltar bsham// bca' tshogs thams cad dpe'u ris ltar bya// de nas skad cig dran rdzogs bdag bskyed ni/ bdag nyid 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// sku mdog sngon po gri gug thod khrag 'dzin// zhal gcig ma he'i zhal can zhabs gnyis bsgrad/ khro bo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par gsal// ye nas dam ye dbyer med thugs srog hūm̐// de la bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba las// 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas 'jigs byed kyi// rnam par spyan drangs bdag la thim par gyur// oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa:

ces bsnyen no// mdun bskyed ni/ āḥ stong pa'i ngang las me ri rdor ra dang*// chos 'byung 'dab brgyad pad nyi dregs pa'i steng*// hūm̐ las rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog mthing*// zhal gcig ma he'i zhal dang phyag bzhi pa// gri gug thod khrag mdung dang rdo rje 'dzin/ khro bo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par gsal// de yi thugs las 'od zer 'phros pa yis// phyogs skyong bcu po srid gsum lha 'dre'i tshogs// spyan drangs pad 'dab bcu la 'khod par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi bī kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ṣa ya dzaḥ khro bo sku smad phur pa can rnams 'phros/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ phyogs skyong rnams kyi spyi bor phur pas btab// kun kyang 'jigs byed gtso bo lta bu la// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur// hūm̐/ rgyal ba kun yab bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs// chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje'i dbang gis khro bo'i skur bzhengs nas// gdug pa 'dul phyir 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs la// drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tiṣ+ṭha lhanaḥ a ti pū hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ dbang lhas dbang bskur gtso 'khor thams cad la// rigs bdag mi bskyod pa yis dbu brgyan gyur// ling ga bran la/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum gyi tshogs// rdo rje 'jigs byed lha tshogs bden pa'i mthus// gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad 'dir khug cig /lcags kyus khug la zhags pas dam du chings// lcags sgrog sdoms la dril bus gzugs la phob// tho bas rdungs la dgra s+t+was tshal par khos// rdo rjes gzir la phur bus dam du thob// ral gris gtubs la sha khrag tshogs su rol// dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag ngo bo la// rnam pa phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

shāka thub la sogs brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed 'khor bcas la// sman raka gtor gsum phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri bā ra sarba bigh+nān sha trūṃ mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum/ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ sarba pañca a mṛta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jam dpal khros pa'i rgyal// de mthong khro bo gzhan 'dar lag cha 'chor// sangs rgyas khros pa rnams kyang za bas bsdigs// 'jigs byed chen po 'khor dang bcas la bstod// dus gsum sangs rgyas mtshan kun thos pa bas// lan gcig 'jam dpal mtshan thos mchog gsungs na// bdag la byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad stsol// bdag cag 'khor bcas srung bskyab mdzad du gsol// de nas drug cu zan re res gso zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya: ya me do ru: ṇa yo da ya: ya da yo ni: ra ya k+ṣe ya: ya k+ṣe yats+tsha: ni ra ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri bā ra sarba bigh+nān sha trūṃ mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces drug cu rtsa bzhis phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs/ pañca a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐/ gshin rje gshed kyi rnam 'phrul phyogs skyong bcu// 'khor dang bcas pas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas la gnod pa yi// byad kha dgra bgegs nad gdon thams cad zlog /dus min 'chi dang 'jigs pa bcu drug zlog /sdang dgra gdon bgegs thams cad rdul du rlog /dam la ma 'da' bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// las gshin gtor ma skabs 'dir yin yang mi dgos gsungs so// de nas gtor ma lho phyogs grong zad par khyer bcug la/ der las gshin la gtad par bsams la/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed bka' byung gis// las kyi gshin rje 'khor bcas 'dir nyon cig

/nyes med sems can mang po gsod pa bas// nyes chen dgra bgegs 'di ni myur du sod// las mkhan ya ma da ṭis lcags kyus zungs// gshin rje kā la pā shas zhags pas chings// ya ma da ṭis be con mgo la rgyob// ya ma dan ti tra yis za bar gyis// 'khor tshogs gshin rje pho mo 'bum// las kyi me long dgra la ston/ nad kyi rkyal pa dgra la phyes// tshon gyi gru gu dgra la rkyongs// bdud kyi khram bam dgra la rgyob// shwa rdil dkar nag dgra la spungs// 'khor lo gsal shing mdung rnon sogs// mtshon cha'i char pa dgra la phob// las kyi gshin rje khyed rnams kyang*// rgyal po blon po sde dpon sogs// pho nya bran g.yog bud med gzugs// drel rta bong bu chu bya dang*// rlung nag 'tshubs ma rta ru zhon// myur mgyogs bar snang glog bzhin du// dmigs bya'i dgra bo 'di khrid la// lho phyogs gshin rje'i yul du song*// las 'di myur du ma bsgrubs na/ khyed rnams dam tshig nyams par 'gyur// dam zas mna' chu'i gtor ma zo// dam tshig rdo rje snying la gnas// nyams na brlag par gdon mi za// de bas ma g.yel las mdzod cig /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha/ dgra bgegs bla srog gtor ma bcas// las gshin 'khor dang bcas pas khyer// sa 'og gshin rje'i yul du song*// sarba ya ma gats+tsha/ rjes chog ni/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ ye shes gshin rje phyogs skyong 'khor bcas la// mchod cing bstod de nyes pa thams cad bshags// spyan drangs lha rnams rang gnas badz+ra mu// dam tshig pa rnams 'od zhu rang la thim// rang nyid mtha' nas dbus yal stong par gyur// dge bas bcom ldan 'jam dpal myur 'grub shog / sprul sku'i bka' yis shin tu nyung bsdus pa// gyis gsungs bzhin du rā ga a s+yas sbyar// nyes pa mchis bshags dge ba byang chub bsngo// maṅga laṃ/ sid+dhi dza ya a la la ho/
